tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in clean, transparent watch glass or glass dish to detect any foreign particles, conformance of colour & compliance with the visual specifications.

details.specification: a white powder, melts at about 75°
details.reference: USP 2024 Monograph for Vitamin E Succinate

tests.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:28

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg of sample in a stoppered tube. Stepwise add solvent: 0.1 mL, 0.9 mL, 2 mL, 7 mL with 1 min vigorous shaking and 15 min hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C; if undissolved test 10 mg in 10 mL then 1 mg in 10 mL. Repeat with acetone, alcohol, ether, chloroform.

details.specification: very soluble in chloroform; soluble in alcohol, in ether, in acetone, and in vegetable oils; practically insoluble in water.

tests.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:29

tests.procedure: Transfer sample equivalent to 200 mg alpha tocopherol to 250 mL flask, dissolve in 50 mL dehydrated alcohol, reflux 1 min. Add 1 g KOH pellets through condenser, reflux 20 min. Add 2 mL HCl dropwise, cool, transfer to 500 mL separator, rinse with 100 mL water and 100 mL ether. Extract aqueous layer with two 50-mL portions of ether. Wash combined ether with four 100-mL portions water. Evaporate ether until 7-8 mL remain, complete without heat. Dissolve in alcoholic sulfuric acid (1 in 72) to 200 mL. To 10 mL add 2 mL nitric acid with swirling, heat at ~75 °C for 15 min. A bright red or orange color develops.

details.expected: Bright red to orange color develops
details.reference: USP 2024 Monograph for Vitamin E Succinate

tests.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:30

tests.procedure: Transfer sample solution from Identification A equivalent to 100 mg alpha tocopheryl acid succinate to separator, add 200 mL water, extract with 75 mL then 25 mL ether. Add 20 mL of potassium ferricyanide (1 in 10) in NaOH (1 in 125) solution, shake 3 min. Wash ether with four 50-mL portions water, dry over anhydrous Na2SO4, evaporate without heat. Dissolve residue in 5.0 mL 2,2,4-trimethylpentane. Measure on calibrated polarimeter using concentration determined in assay. NLT +24°.

details.sample: solution from ID-A equivalent to 100 mg alpha tocopheryl acid succinate

tests.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:30

tests.procedure: Dissolve 1.0 g sample in 25 mL diluent (equal parts alcohol and ether, neutralized to phenolphthalein with 0.1 N NaOH). Add 0.5 mL phenolphthalein TS. Titrate with 0.10 N sodium hydroxide until solution remains faintly pink after shaking for 30 s. Requires 18.0–19.3 mL of 0.10 N sodium hydroxide.

details.reference: USP 2024 Monograph for Vitamin E Succinate

tests.source: D-Alpha Tocopherol Succinate__STM for Alpha tocopherol Succinate.txt:33

tests.procedure: Gas chromatography with internal standard. Internal standard: 10 mg/mL squalane in cyclohexane. Standard: 30.0 mg USP Alpha Tocopheryl Acid Succinate RS in 20-mL vial + 2.0 mL methanol + 1.0 mL 2,2-dimethoxypropane + 0.1 mL HCl, sonicate, stand in dark 1 h ± 5 min, evaporate just to dryness with stream of nitrogen, dissolve in 3.0 mL internal standard solution. Sample: 30.0 mg prepared identically. GC-FID: 0.25-mm x 30-m fused silica capillary (phase G2 0.25 µm), He carrier at 1 mL/min, split 100:1, column 280 °C, injector 290 °C, detector 290 °C, 1 µL injection. Result % = (RU/RS) x (CS/CU) x 100.

details.column: 0.25-mm x 30-m fused silica capillary, film 0.25 µm phase G2
standards: USP Alpha Tocopheryl Acid Succinate RS
details.derivatization: methanol + 2,2-dimethoxypropane + HCl, 1 h in dark, dry under N2
details.reference: USP <621>; USP 2024 Monograph for Vitamin E Succinate
